manifest.claim_text: Scale hallucination is controlled for. Primary metric: Coverage and error at each native scale; high-frequency energy calibration.
manifest.falsified_by: The mandatory control (Withhold fine-scale evidence while retaining coarse data; compare uncertainty and reconstruction to a coarse-only model) shows the result survives only without it.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Minimum interpretation enforced: Fine detail is valid only where source support or tested prior justifies it
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No prospective human TMS/tFUS protocol is implemented or implied (build order stops at item 5; item 6 is out of scope: no IRB, no consent, no participants).
